claim: On 2023-11-26 Amazon EFS added a new storage class, EFS Archive, together with file system types and the Transition into Archive lifecycle policy. EFS now offers three storage classes: EFS Standard, EFS Infrequent Access (EFS IA) and EFS Archive.
note: requests-23 for fr-0099: changed.was 'not available' is the old value of the EFS Archive storage class and the Transition into Archive lifecycle policy only (history row 'New storage class, file system types, and lifecycle policy', November 26, 2023). It is not true of One Zone storage: the same document history has the row 'Support added for EFS One Zone storage classes' of March 9, 2021, so before 2023-11-26 One Zone existed as the One Zone and One Zone-IA storage classes; the 2023 change regrouped them as the One Zone file system type. A Changed recently entry with Old: not available must name EFS Archive, not the One Zone or Regional file system types. Older material uses the names Standard-IA and One Zone-IA.
